Name: Aesop's Garden
Overview:
Aesop's Garden is a puzzle game in which the player must guide Aesop round his garden moving blocks and activating switches whilst avoiding traps.

After his prize winning garden is destroyed by his rival Alistair August in an attempt to keep him from winning another gardening competition, Aesop must now re-build his garden in time for a big gardening competition. The player takes control of Aesop and must go through his garden digging up every weed through each level.
